selection: Three random reviewed effects per family, seed 473; selected before scoring.

queries.N378: A teal spell seal with a central polygon and tiny glyphs circling its rim rotates and dims.
queries.N072: A gray puffy cloud swells into an uneven hollow outline, then rises and thins.
queries.N185: Pale smoke twists upward in long thin ribbon wisps before dissolving.
queries.N187: Rounded dusty brown smoke lobes swell and peel away as the puff rises.
